name: OludolapoAnalyst/AirBnB
what_it_holds: The well-known 'Airbnb Prices in European Cities' collection: 10 European cities (Amsterdam, Athens, Barcelona, Berlin, Budapest, Lisbon, London, Paris, Rome, Vienna), each with a *_weekdays.csv and *_weekends.csv file (20 CSVs total). Fields include price, room type, superhost status, amenity counts, distance to center, attraction/restaurant indices. Original source scrape circa 2018-19, CC0 licensed. This repo re-hosts/re-packages it for a SQL+PowerBI project.
why_useful: Multi-city European snapshot with a weekday/weekend price split not present in our Inside Airbnb panel (which has no Rome/Paris/London day-of-week price granularity for that vintage); useful as an older cross-section comparator for European ADR levels/gap 1 (older archived data) and gap 20 (day-of-week demand pattern proxy).
size_hint: 20 CSV files, city-level listing counts (hundreds-thousands/city typical of this Kaggle dataset)
duplicate_of_holding: Same underlying source data as widely-mirrored 'Airbnb Prices in European Cities' Kaggle set; not identical to our held 13-city Inside Airbnb panel (different cities: Athens, Budapest, Vienna, Berlin not all in our panel) or vintage (pre-Dec-2022).
themes: Kaggle-style Airbnb listing snapshot datasets committed to GitHub (any city, any year), especially multi-year or multi-city collections
why_all: Multi-city European snapshot with a weekday/weekend price split not present in our Inside Airbnb panel (which has no Rome/Paris/London day-of-week price granularity for that vintage); useful as an older cross-section comparator for European ADR levels/gap 1 (older archived data) and gap 20 (day-of-week demand pattern proxy).
Yet another mirror of the same 10-EU-city dataset family; low incremental value beyond the primary kraina/HF and Zenodo copies but confirms the dataset is widely re-hosted and stable.

name: kraina/airbnb (mirror of Gyódi & Nawaro EU-cities dataset)
what_it_holds: 51.7k row Parquet dataset (25.5k weekday + 26.2k weekend offers) across 10 European cities (Amsterdam, Athens, Barcelona, Berlin, Budapest, Lisbon, London, Paris, Rome, Vienna), originally the supplementary data for Gyódi & Nawaro (2021) 'Determinants of Airbnb prices in European cities: A spatial econometrics approach', mirrored from Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.4446043) onto Hugging Face by the Kraina geospatial research group. Fields include price, room type, host status (superhost), ratings/review count, capacity, bedrooms, distance to center, and a TripAdvisor-based attractiveness index. CC-BY-4.0.
why_useful: A cross-sectional but multi-city (10 EU cities), academically-vetted realised-price dataset with weekday/weekend price splits — useful as an independent check on ADR/seasonality mix assumptions for EMEA, and the underlying Zenodo record + paper's methodology (spatial regression on price determinants) is a candidate replication package for the ADR decomposition workstream. Not new geography beyond what we hold (Paris, Barcelona, Rome overlap our 13-city panel) but adds Athens, Budapest, Lisbon, Vienna and a peer-reviewed price-driver framework.
geography: 10 EU cities (Amsterdam, Athens, Barcelona, Berlin, Budapest, Lisbon, London, Paris, Rome, Vienna)
time_coverage: single cross-sectional pull (~2018-2020 per paper vintage; exact scrape date not stated on HF page)
last_activity: Zenodo record published 2021; HF mirror undated
duplicate_of_holding: Partial overlap in geography with our 13-city Inside Airbnb panel (Paris, Barcelona, Rome) but different data source/vintage and includes weekday/weekend price split we do not have

Not new geography beyond what we hold (Paris, Barcelona, Rome overlap our 13-city panel) but adds Athens, Budapest, Lisbon, Vienna and a peer-reviewed price-driver framework.

name: tranthienmy22/airbnb-listings-analysis-5-asian-cities
what_it_holds: Five committed Inside Airbnb CSVs (Bangkok, Tokyo, Taipei, Hong Kong, Singapore) dated June 2023, plus a Power BI dashboard. Explicit host-professionalisation analysis: host listing-count distributions per city (e.g. ~2/3 of Bangkok hosts single-listing; ~1/3 of Hong Kong hosts have 100+ listings; top-10 hosts hold 6.7% of all listings), and discussion of how Japan's 2018 registration law and Singapore's minimum-stay rules reshaped host composition.
why_useful: APAC-city Inside Airbnb snapshots (Bangkok, Tokyo, Taipei, Hong Kong, Singapore) that are NOT in our current 13-city / 120-market panel roster as far as this scout can tell from CONTEXT.md's named cities — worth checking whether these fill APAC geography gaps (gap #7 adjacent) even though the underlying source is Inside Airbnb (so any value is in already-committed vintage/geography we may not have captured, not a new data source).

name: Zenodo: Determinants of Airbnb prices in European cities (supplementary data)
what_it_holds: Original Zenodo record (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.4446043) for the Gyódi & Nawaro paper: per-city weekday/weekend CSVs for 10 EU cities plus the Python spatial-econometrics replication scripts (not just the flat data — includes the modeling code).
why_useful: This is the authoritative source behind the kraina/HF and multiple GitHub mirrors above; unlike the mirrors, it also ships the actual spatial-regression replication code, which is a genuine academic replication package (methods) for price-determinant modeling, relevant to the ADR decomposition workstream (methods gap #17 adjacent).
